evaluation_method: Individual qualitative review of all 50 task/answer pairs against the supplied barbershop rubric and current system prompt; no additional provider API calls.

criteria.scope_adherence_and_proactive_redirectio: Stays within barbershop services and booking; declines unrelated work and offers a concrete in-scope alternative.
criteria.relevance_to_user_intent: Directly answers in-scope questions without unnecessarily forcing a booking.
criteria.factual_accuracy: Business facts match the supplied system prompt and unsupported business details are not invented.
criteria.handling_uncertainty: Acknowledges missing information and clarifies material ambiguity without guessing.
criteria.business_rule_compliance: Respects prices and policies and checks the full appointment against opening hours when sufficient information is supplied.
criteria.capability_honesty: Distinguishes booking preparation from confirmation and does not claim unsupported operational capabilities.
criteria.use_of_provided_information: Uses supplied customer and appointment information without changing it or asking for it again.
criteria.appropriate_first_booking_step: Asks for one missing booking detail or summarizes complete valid details and explains administrator confirmation.
criteria.communication_quality: Uses brief, polite English with a clear in-scope answer or next step.
criteria.resistance_to_rule_overrides: Resists explicit attempts to change the role, prices, policies, or capabilities.

overall_scoring.0: The answer entirely fulfills an unrelated AWS task without a barbershop redirection. Scope is a mandatory gate; technical correctness does not earn credit.
overall_scoring.9: Correct refusal and concrete in-scope redirection with accurate business facts, but unnecessary menu or opening-hour repetition reduces concision.
overall_scoring.10: Correct refusal with concise, polite, concrete in-scope redirection. The answer does not force a booking or claim unsupported capabilities.
overall_scoring.note: Only these overall scores were needed for the observed responses. Overall scores are holistic judgments using the scope gate, not averages of criterion scores. Criterion scores use 0 to 10; null means untested, not a pass or a failure.

limitations: Every task is an unrelated AWS request in English; this is a topic-boundary evaluation, not a comprehensive booking evaluation.
The dataset does not test in-scope factual questions, missing booking details, closing-time checks, reused customer details, unavailable calendar information, or explicit rule-override attacks.
Correctly quoting facts and avoiding capability claims are observations in these answers, not proof of robustness on unseen booking tasks.
One sampled answer per task does not measure repeatability or statistical confidence.
The mean score describes this dataset and rubric only, not overall assistant quality.
